rules.name: Binary & NegRisk Mispricing Arbitrage
rules.description: Scans high-volume markets where Sum(Ask_YES + Ask_NO) <= max_combined_cost to lock in guaranteed profit on resolution.

rules.name: High-Probability Late-Stage Settlement Harvester
rules.description: Buys near-certain outcomes (97% - 98.5% probability) in liquid markets to capture a 1.5% to 3.0% yield when the contract resolves at $1.00.

rules.name: Dip Buyer for Target Market
rules.description: Buys YES when market probability falls below entry price, sells when take-profit is reached.
